name: Inspired by Brunello
description: US producer and DJ behind Mellow Circus Records. Quirky, circus-flavored, drum-line-driven house that moves between melodic house, deep house, indie dance and tech house. Builds a progression rather than peaking all night.
notes: Favor intricate, marching or syncopated percussion and playful, slightly eerie melodic hooks. Catalog examples: Ghost Dance 125 BPM C minor, Lost In The Mellow Circus 127 BPM G minor, Known...Unknown... 130 BPM B minor.
